outlet: Walla Walla Union-Bulletin, "Columbia County Park and Recreation Pool District question aims to start renovation project" (Julia Eastham, 2024-10-16)
notes: Background on the 2024 levy: district formed by vote in 2023, five commissioners; Dayton pool closed since 2017 and filled with dirt in 2022; levy funds district operations (election fees, insurance, legal) and later pool maintenance; construction to be grant-funded; nearest pool in Prescott.
